ayahs.transliteration: aw zid ʿalayhi warattili l-qur'āna tartīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: অথবা তার চেয়ে বাড়াও, আর ধীরে ধীরে সুস্পষ্টভাবে কুরআন পাঠ কর।
ayahs.translation_en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
ayahs.conventional_en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অথবা তার চেয়ে বাড়াও, আর ধীরে ধীরে সুস্পষ্টভাবে কুরআন পাঠ কর।
ayahs.meta_bn: তারতীলের সাথে কুরআন পাঠ: স্পষ্ট, ধীর ও ছন্দোময় সুরে তিলাওয়াত করার নির্দেশ

ayahs.transliteration: innā sanul'qī ʿalayka qawlan thaqīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তোমার উপর গুরুভার কালাম নাযিল করব (বিশ্বের বুকে যার প্রচার ও প্রতিষ্ঠা করার দায়িত্বভার অতি বড় কঠিন কাজ)।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আমি তোমার উপর গুরুভার কালাম নাযিল করব (বিশ্বের বুকে যার প্রচার ও প্রতিষ্ঠা করার দায়িত্বভার অতি বড় কঠিন কাজ)।

english_translations.shakir: Surely We will make to light upon you a weighty Word.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We are about to reveal to you a mighty word.

english_translations.arberry: Behold, We shall cast upon thee a weighty word;

ayahs.transliteration: inna nāshi-ata al-layli hiya ashaddu waṭan wa-aqwamu qīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: বাস্তবিকই রাতে বিছানা ছেড়ে উঠা আত্মসংযমের জন্য বেশি কার্যকর এবং (কুরআন) স্পষ্ট উচ্চারণের অনুকূল।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
ayahs.conventional_bn: বাস্তবিকই রাতে বিছানা ছেড়ে উঠা আত্মসংযমের জন্য বেশি কার্যকর এবং (কুরআন) স্পষ্ট উচ্চারণের অনুকূল।
ayahs.meta_bn: রাত্রিকালীন ইবাদতের গভীরতা: রাতের জাগরণে অন্তরের একাগ্রতা ও সুদৃঢ় বাক্যোচ্চারণ

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
english_translations.shakir: Surely the rising by night is the firmest way to tread and the best corrective of speech.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Prayer at night leaves the strongest impression on one's soul and the words spoken are more consistent.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, the rising by night (for Tahajjud prayer) is very hard and most potent and good for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (understanding) the Word (of Allah).
english_translations.arberry: surely the first part of the night is heavier in tread, more upright in speech,

ayahs.transliteration: inna laka fī l-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: দিনের বেলায় তোমার জন্য আছে দীর্ঘ কর্মব্যস্ততা।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
ayahs.conventional_bn: দিনের বেলায় তোমার জন্য আছে দীর্ঘ কর্মব্যস্ততা।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا: dynamic movement through the stream of daily social responsibilities.

english_translations.shakir: Surely you have in the day time a long occupation.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: During the day, you are preoccupied with many activities.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties,
english_translations.arberry: surely in the day thou hast long business.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabtīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই তুমি তোমার প্রতিপালকের নাম স্মরণ কর এবং একাগ্রচিত্তে তাঁর প্রতি মগ্ন হও।
ayahs.translation_en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
ayahs.conventional_en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
ayahs.conventional_bn: কাজেই তুমি তোমার প্রতিপালকের নাম স্মরণ কর এবং একাগ্রচিত্তে তাঁর প্রতি মগ্ন হও।

english_translations.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
english_translations.shakir: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with (exclusive) devotion.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Lord of the eastern and western regions, with due sincerity.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.
english_translations.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him very devoutly.

ayahs.transliteration: rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-ittakhidh'hu wakīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: (তিনি) পূর্ব ও পশ্চিমের সর্বময় কর্তা, তিনি ছাড়া সত্যিকারের কোন ইলাহ নেই, অতএব তাঁকেই তুমি তোমার কার্য সম্পদানকারী বানিয়ে লও।
ayahs.translation_en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
ayahs.conventional_en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
ayahs.conventional_bn: (তিনি) পূর্ব ও পশ্চিমের সর্বময় কর্তা, তিনি ছাড়া সত্যিকারের কোন ইলাহ নেই, অতএব তাঁকেই তুমি তোমার কার্য সম্পদানকারী বানিয়ে লও।
ayahs.meta_bn: পূর্ব ও পশ্চিমের সার্বভৌম অধিপতি: একমাত্র উপাস্য আল্লাহকে সার্বিক কর্মবিধায়ক (উকিল) গ্রহণ
ayahs.meta_en: Cosmic Axis of Sovereignty: Lord of the Dual Horizons and Supreme Trustee (Wakil)

english_translations.arberry: Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for a Guardian.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-uh'jur'hum hajran jamīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা যা বলে সে ব্যাপারে ধৈর্য ধারণ কর আর ভদ্রতার সঙ্গে তাদেরকে পরিহার ক’রে চল।
ayahs.translation_en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
ayahs.conventional_en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা যা বলে সে ব্যাপারে ধৈর্য ধারণ কর আর ভদ্রতার সঙ্গে তাদেরকে পরিহার ক’রে চল।
ayahs.meta_bn: অপবাদের মুখে শান্ত ধৈর্য: বিরোধীদের কটূক্তিতে ধৈর্য ধারণ এবং শালীনভাবে পরিহার
ayahs.meta_en: Stoic Resilience Protocol: Enduring Hostile Discourse with Dignified Non-Engagement
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا: non-violent, constructive strategic disengagement without bitterness.

english_translations.pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
english_translations.shakir: And bear patiently what they say and avoid them with a becoming avoidance.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Bear patiently whatever they say, do not yield to them and keep on preaching decently to them.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And be patient (O Muhammad SAW) with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.
english_translations.arberry: And bear thou patiently what they say, and forsake them graciously.

ayahs.transliteration: wadharnī wal-mukadhibīna ulī l-naʿmati wamahhil'hum qalīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আর ছেড়ে দাও আমাকে আর নানান বিলাস সামগ্রীর মালিক ঐ মিথ্যুকদেরকে এবং তাদেরকে কিছুটা সময় অবকাশ দাও।
ayahs.translation_en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
ayahs.conventional_en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর ছেড়ে দাও আমাকে আর নানান বিলাস সামগ্রীর মালিক ঐ মিথ্যুকদেরকে এবং তাদেরকে কিছুটা সময় অবকাশ দাও।
ayahs.meta_bn: বিলাসী অস্বীকারকারীদের অবকাশ: প্রাচুর্যশালী মিথ্যারোপকারীদের বিচারের ভার আল্লাহর উপর ন্যস্ত
ayahs.meta_en: Divine Respite Strategy: Entrusting Affluent Deniers to Systemic Containment
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ: elite beneficiaries of affluent systems blinded by luxury.

english_translations.sahih_international: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
english_translations.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
english_translations.shakir: And leave Me and the rejecters, the possessors of ease and plenty, and respite them a little.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Leave the prosperous disbelievers to Me and give them respite for a little while;
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers (those who deny My Verses, etc.), and those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.
english_translations.arberry: Leave Me to those who cry lies, those prosperous ones, and respite them a little,

ayahs.transliteration: inna ladaynā ankālan wajaḥīman
ayahs.translation_bn: আমার কাছে আছে শেকল আর দাউ দাউ করে জ্বলা আগুন,
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

english_translations.pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
english_translations.shakir: Surely with Us are heavy fetters and a flaming fire,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have prepared for them fetters, flaming fire,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.
english_translations.arberry: for with Us there are fetters, and a furnace,

ayahs.transliteration: waṭaʿāman dhā ghuṣṣatin waʿadhāban alīman
ayahs.translation_bn: আর গলায় আটকে যায় এমন খাবার আর মর্মান্তিক শাস্তি।
ayahs.translation_en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
ayahs.conventional_en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর গলায় আটকে যায় এমন খাবার আর মর্মান্তিক শাস্তি।

ayahs.transliteration: yawma tarjufu l-arḍu wal-jibālu wakānati l-jibālu kathīban mahīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: (এসব শাস্তি দেয়া হবে) যেদিন যমীন আর পাহাড়গুলো কেঁপে উঠবে, আর পাহাড়গুলো হবে চলমান বালুকারাশি।
ayahs.translation_en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
ayahs.conventional_en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
ayahs.conventional_bn: (এসব শাস্তি দেয়া হবে) যেদিন যমীন আর পাহাড়গুলো কেঁপে উঠবে, আর পাহাড়গুলো হবে চলমান বালুকারাশি।
ayahs.meta_bn: ভূকম্পন ও পর্বতমালার রূপান্তর: পৃথিবী ও পাহাড় প্রকম্পিত হয়ে বালুকণায় পরিণত হওয়া
ayahs.meta_en: Planetary Geological Liquefaction: Seismic Convulsion of Mountains into Drifting Dunes
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: تَرْجُفُ: intense tectonic shockwave and vibration; كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا: solid rock masses liquifying and crumbling into weightless sand drifts.

english_translations.pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
english_translations.shakir: On the day when the earth and the mountains shall quake and the mountains shall become (as) heaps of sand let loose.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, the earth and the mountains will be violently shaken, and the mountains will be turned into heaps of moving sand.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
english_translations.arberry: upon the day when the earth and the mountains shall quake and the mountains become a slipping heap of sand.

ayahs.transliteration: innā arsalnā ilaykum rasūlan shāhidan ʿalaykum kamā arsalnā ilā fir'ʿawna rasūlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তোমাদের কাছে তেমনিভাবে একজন রসূলকে তোমাদের প্রতি সাক্ষ্যদাতা হিসেবে পাঠিয়েছি (যিনি ক্বিয়ামতে সাক্ষ্য দিবেন যে, দ্বীনের দাওয়াত তিনি যথাযথভাবে মানুষের কাছে পৌঁছে দিয়েছেন) যেমনভাবে আমি ফেরাউনের কাছে পাঠিয়েছিলাম একজন রসূলকে।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আমি তোমাদের কাছে তেমনিভাবে একজন রসূলকে তোমাদের প্রতি সাক্ষ্যদাতা হিসেবে পাঠিয়েছি (যিনি ক্বিয়ামতে সাক্ষ্য দিবেন যে, দ্বীনের দাওয়াত তিনি যথাযথভাবে মানুষের কাছে পৌঁছে দিয়েছেন) যেমনভাবে আমি ফেরাউনের কাছে পাঠিয়েছিলাম একজন রসূলকে।

ayahs.meta_en: Historical Parallels of Warning: The Prophetic Archetype Sent as Forensic Witness
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: شَاهِدًا: forensic moral witness establishing evidential liability.

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
english_translations.shakir: Surely We have sent to you an Apostle, a witness against you, as We sent an apostle to Firon.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have sent you a Messenger, who will witness your deeds, just as We sent a Messenger to the Pharaoh.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have sent to you (O men) a Messenger (Muhammad SAW) to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger [Musa (Moses)] to Fir'aun (Pharaoh).
english_translations.arberry: Surely We have sent unto you a Messenger as a witness over you, even as We sent to Pharaoh a Messenger,

ayahs.transliteration: faʿaṣā fir'ʿawnu l-rasūla fa-akhadhnāhu akhdhan wabīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: তখন ফেরাউন সেই রসূলকে অমান্য করল। ফলে আমি তাকে শক্ত ধরায় ধরলাম।
ayahs.translation_en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালক জানেন যে, তুমি কখনও রাতের দু’তৃতীয়াংশ ‘ইবাদাতের জন্য দাঁড়াও, কখনও অর্ধেক, কখনও রাতের এক তৃতীয়াংশ, তোমার সঙ্গী-সাথীদের একটি দলও (তাই করে)। আল্লাহ্ই রাত আর দিনের পরিমাণ নির্ধারণ করেন। তিনি জানেন, তোমরা তা যথাযথ হিসাব রেখে পালন করতে পারবে না। কাজেই তিনি তোমাদের প্রতি ক্ষমাপরবশ হয়েছেন। কাজেই কুরআনের যতটুকু পড়া তোমার জন্য সহজ হয়, তুমি ততটুকু পড়। তিনি জানেন, তোমাদের মধ্যে কেউ কেউ অসুস্থ হবে, আর কতক আল্লাহর অনুগ্রহ সন্ধানে যমীনে ভ্রমণ করবে, আর কতক আল্লাহর পথে যুদ্ধ করবে। কাজেই তোমাদের জন্য যতটুকু সহজসাধ্য হয় তাই তাত্থেকে পাঠ কর, আর নামায প্রতিষ্ঠা কর, যাকাত দাও আর আল্লাহকে ঋণ দাও উত্তম ঋণ। তোমরা যা কিছু কল্যাণ নিজেদের জন্য আগে পাঠাবে, তা আল্লাহর নিকট (সঞ্চিত) পাবে, তাই উত্তম এবং পুরস্কার হিসেবে খুব বড়। তোমরা আল্লাহর নিকট ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা কর, আল্লাহ অতি ক্ষমাশীল, বড়ই দয়ালু।

words.translation_en: so He has turned in mercy

ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

english_translations.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english_translations.shakir: Surely your Lord knows that you pass in prayer nearly two-thirds of the night, and (sometimes) half of it, and (sometimes) a third of it, and (also) a party of those with you; and Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you are not able to do it, so He has turned to you (mercifully), therefore read what is easy of the Quran. He knows that there must be among you sick, and others who travel in the land seeking of the bounty of Allah, and others who fight in Allah's way, therefore read as much of it as is easy (to you), and keep up prayer and pay the poor-rate and offer to Allah a goodly gift, and whatever of good you send on beforehand for yourselves, you will find it with Allah; that is best and greatest in reward; and ask forgiveness of Allah; surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord knows that you and a group of those who are with you get up for prayer sometimes for less than two-thirds of the night, sometimes half and sometimes one-third of it. God determines the duration of the night and day. He knew that it would be hard for you to keep an exact account of the timing of the night prayers, so He turned to you with forgiveness. Thus, recite from the Quran as much as possible. He knew that some of you would be sick, others would travel in the land to seek God's favors, and still others would fight for the cause of God. Thus, recite from the Quran as much as possible, be steadfast in prayer, pay the zakat, and give virtuous loans to God. Whatever good deeds you save for the next life, you will certainly find them with God. This is the best investment, and for this you will find the greatest reward. Ask forgiveness from God. God is All-forgiving and All-merciful.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so do a party of those with you, And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you (in mercy). So, recite you of the Quran as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's Bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause. So recite as much of the Quran as may be easy (for you), and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) and give Zakat, and lend to Allah a goodly loan, and whatever good you send before you for yourselves, (i.e. Nawafil non-obligatory acts of worship: prayers, charity, fasting, Hajj and 'Umrah, etc.), you will certainly find it with Allah, better and greater in reward. And seek Forgiveness of Allah. Verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
english_translations.arberry: Thy Lord knows that thou keepest vigil nearly two-thirds of the night, or a half of it, or a third of it, and a party of those with thee; and God determines the night and the day. He knows that you will not number it, and He has turned towards you. Therefore recite of the Koran so much as is feasible. He knows that some of you are sick, and others journeying in the land, seeking the bounty of God, and others fighting in the way of God. So recite of it so much as is feasible. And perform the prayer, and pay the alms, and lend to God a good loan. Whatever good you shall forward to your souls' account, you shall find it with God as better, and mightier a wage. And ask God's forgiveness; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
